rationale: The story hinges on a single physical action—whether a deadbolt retracts during an outage. An extreme macro photograph of the bolt mechanism emphasizes the physical reality of the lock contrasting with the invisible digital networks it relies on.
cue: what has to be alive for the bolt to retract
subject: A heavy brushed-steel smart deadbolt extending from a door edge.
core_thesis: A 2027 door lock is a choice between four different meanings of local control, ultimately boiling down to what external network must stay alive for the physical bolt to retract.
core_conflict: The promise of local hardware autonomy versus the hidden vulnerabilities of hub, cloud, and neighborhood network dependencies.
